notes:
### Product Overview
Fathom is an AI-powered meeting assistant designed to record, transcribe, and summarize virtual meetings across platforms like Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.
* **Source URL:** `https://www.fathom.ai/pricing`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"free plan unlimited recordings, instant call summaries, integrations with llms & more. sign up. free forever."`

---

### Authentication Methods
Fathom's public API supports two primary authentication methods:
1. **API Key Authentication:** Utilizes a static key passed via the `X-Api-Key` header (referred to as `apikeyauth` in their SDKs).
2. **Bearer Token Authentication:** Utilizes an OAuth 2.0 access token (`bearer_token`).

For a multi-tenant integration platform like Composio, **OAuth 2.0** is the designated method.
* **Source URL:** `https://developers.fathom.ai/sdks/authentication`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"api key authentication ... bearer token authentication ... security schemes name type environment variable apikeyauth apikey fathom_api_key_auth bearerauth http fathom_bearer_auth ... use oauth for multi-user integrations"`
* **Source URL:** `https://developers.fathom.ai/oauth`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"if you’re developing a public app that you wish to integrate with fathom, you should build it using oauth."`

---

### Credentials Acquisition and Cost
* **API Keys:** Any user can instantly generate an API key from their account settings panel.
  * **Source URL:** `https://developers.fathom.ai/quickstart`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"head to the api access section of your user settings and generate an api key."`
* **OAuth Credentials:** Developers can instantly register a public application and receive a Client ID and Client Secret via the developer portal.
  * **Source URL:** `https://developers.fathom.ai/oauth`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"register your app register an oauth app configure your redirects and receive your oauth credentials. (2 mins)"`
* **Cost:** Access to the public API is completely free and included across all subscription tiers, including the free tier.
  * **Source URL:** `https://www.fathom.ai/pricing`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"HubSpot, Salesforce, public API included on all plans."`
* **Access Verdict:** `access: self_serve_free`

---

### API Technical Details
* **API Style:** REST API utilizing standard HTTP methods (GET, POST) and JSON payloads.
  * **Source URL:** `https://developers.fathom.ai/quickstart`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `curl https://api.fathom.ai/external/v1/meetings \ -h "x-api-key: your_api_key"`
* **Breadth:** The API provides comprehensive access to meetings, recordings, AI summaries, transcripts, teams, team members, users, and webhooks.
  * **Source URL:** `https://developers.fathom.ai/quickstart`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Meetings. GET. List meetings · GET. List meeting types. Recordings. Teams. Team Members. Users. Webhooks. Webhook Payloads."`
* **OpenAPI Spec:** No direct download link for a raw JSON/YAML OpenAPI specification file is explicitly provided in the public documentation, though the developer portal is built on Mintlify using an underlying OpenAPI definition.
* **Webhooks:** Fully supported for real-time meeting event notifications.
  * **Source URL:** `https://developers.fathom.ai/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"webhooks set up a webhook for your meetings."`
* **Sandbox:** None found. There is no mention of a dedicated sandbox or test environment in the official developer documentation.

---

### Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers
Fathom provides an official, vendor-hosted MCP server integration to connect meeting data directly to AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT.
* **Source URL:** `https://www.fathom.ai/pricing`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"public api & mcp see all integrations →"`
* **Source URL:** `https://developers.fathom.ai/`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets you connect Fathom to AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT... To learn more about Fathom's MCP and how to connect it to any other MCP-compatible tool, visit api.fathom.ai/mcp."`

Additionally, multiple community-built MCP servers exist on GitHub for local or custom setups.
* **Source URL:** `https://github.com/Dot-Fun/fathom-mcp`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"Model Context Protocol server for Fathom AI"`
* **MCP Verdict:** `mcp: official`

---

### Buildability Verdict
* **Verdict:** `ready_now`
* **Main Blocker:** There are no technical blockers preventing immediate development. Fathom provides comprehensive public documentation, and credentials can be obtained instantly via a free self-serve account. While public OAuth apps are ultimately `"subject to review to ensure the best experience for all users"` (`https://developers.fathom.ai/oauth`), developers can register an app and receive credentials immediately within 2 minutes to begin building and testing right away.
